## Priority Breakdown

### P0: Critical Bug Fixes (Implement First)

#### 1. Empty Capability List Handling (MODERATE ~3h)
**Source:** Cline #13583 (carry-forward from 2026-09-01)

**Problem:** Empty `[]` capability list treated as authoritative denial instead of fail-open. Causes tools to silently drop features when catalog metadata incomplete.

**Solution:**
- Add helper `modelSupportsImageInput` / `declaredCapability` in `src/providers/capabilities.ts`
- Route capability readers through helpers with explicit fail-open default
- Audit sites: `src/tool/tools/read.ts`, `src/providers/format.ts`, `src/providers/model-match.ts`

**Files:**
- `src/providers/capabilities.ts` - Add helpers
- `src/tool/tools/read.ts` - Update image handling
- `src/providers/format.ts` - Update request building
- `tests/providers/capabilities.test.ts` - Add tests

**Done when:**
- [ ] Empty `[]` capability list treated as unspecified, not denial
- [ ] Image attachments NOT stripped when capabilities empty
- [ ] Tests cover empty/undefined/populated capability lists
- [ ] `npm test` passes

### P1: High-Value Security & Reliability (Implement Next)

#### 2. API Key Sanitization + Auth Error Classification (HIGH ~6h)
**Source:** Cline #13549 (carry-forward from 2026-09-01)

**Problem:** 
- Invisible clipboard artifacts (newlines, zero-width spaces, BOM) cause 401s
- Raw provider JSON unhelpful (`{"detail":"Invalid API Key"}`)

**Solution:**
- Strip control chars (`\p{Cc}`), formatting chars (`\p{Cf}`), whitespace from API keys at write boundary
- Classify HTTP 401/403 as `ProviderErrorClass: 'auth'`
- Rewrite auth errors into actionable guidance pointing at settings

**Files:**
- `src/config/index.ts` or `src/providers/auth.ts` - Add sanitization
- `src/core/errors.ts` - Add `'auth'` to `ProviderErrorClass`
- `src/cli/interactive.ts` - Rewrite auth errors for users
- `tests/config/sanitization.test.ts` - Add tests

**Done when:**
- [ ] API keys sanitized on write (strip control/formatting chars, trim whitespace)
- [ ] Whitespace-only value clears key
- [ ] 401/403 classified as `ProviderErrorClass: 'auth'`
- [ ] Auth errors show actionable guidance, not raw JSON
- [ ] Tests cover invisible char stripping
- [ ] `npm test` passes

---

#### 3. Abort Propagation to Subagents (HIGH ~6h)
**Source:** Cline #13677 (carry-forward from 2026-09-01)

**Problem:** Stopping parent task doesn't stop child agents. Runaway subagents consume resources.

**Solution:**
- Thread parent `AbortSignal` to delegated subagent `SessionRuntime`
- Observe signal only during active run (scoped listeners)
- Release delegated sessions after execution
- Inherit parent runtime PID for subagents

**Files:**
- `src/tool/tools/task.ts` - Pass parent signal to child sessions
- `src/core/orchestrator.ts` - Thread signal through delegation
- `src/core/streamingOrchestrator.ts` - Thread signal through delegation
- `src/core/sessionManager.ts` - Add signal lifecycle management
- `tests/tool/tools/task.test.ts` - Add abort tests

**Done when:**
- [ ] Parent abort signal propagates to delegated child agents
- [ ] Signal observed only during active run
- [ ] Delegated sessions released after execution
- [ ] Tests cover parent abort → child stops
- [ ] `npm test` passes

### P2: Performance Optimization (Nice to Have)

#### 4. Environment Details Separation (MODERATE ~4h)
**Source:** Kilocode #13190 (new from today)

**Problem:** 
- `<environment_details>` directly abuts user prompt text
- Prevents caching stable baseline
- Duplicate block injection in repeated loops

**Solution:**
- Separate `<env>` block with blank-line prefix (`\n\n`)
- Update prompt-cache detection to trim leading whitespace before matching
- Prevents duplicate blocks (skip-check failed when blank lines preceded block)

**Files:**
- `src/agent/system.ts` - Update `buildEnvBlock()` injection
- `src/providers/openai/prompt-cache.ts` - Update `applyCacheBreakpoint()`
- `tests/agent/system.test.ts` - Add separation tests

**Done when:**
- [ ] `<env>` block prefixed with `\n\n` separator
- [ ] Cache detection trims leading whitespace
- [ ] No duplicate env blocks in repeated iterations
- [ ] Tests cover duplicate prevention
- [ ] `npm test` passes
